claims.claim: Intuitive's Q1 2026 combined da Vinci/Ion procedures grew about 17%, Ion procedures grew about 39%, revenue grew 23% to $2.77 billion, and the installed bases reached 11,395 da Vinci and 1,041 Ion systems.

factors.name: robotic-surgery platform adoption
factors.basis: Procedure growth, installed-base growth and rising system placements reinforce recurring utilization and platform expansion evidence.

risks.risk: Procedure and installed-base growth do not by themselves establish valuation attractiveness or uninterrupted margin expansion.

unknowns.unknown: Scout did not locate a correctly dated Q2 2026 earnings release in this bounded search and therefore does not infer Q2 results.

claims.claim: Intuitive raised its 2026 worldwide da Vinci procedure-growth outlook in Q1 to approximately 13.5%-15.5% from the prior 13%-15% range; Q1 included 431 da Vinci placements, 232 of them da Vinci 5 systems.

factors.name: expectation conversion
factors.basis: Q1 operating performance supported a modest upward revision to procedure-growth expectations and higher da Vinci 5 placements year over year.

risks.risk: Tariffs and product mix can pressure gross margin even if procedure adoption remains strong; the prior outlook explicitly incorporated tariff impact.

unknowns.unknown: Later-2026 guidance changes require a verified current primary source before being asserted.
